pages.title: Before you submit
pages.note: CASPA's 2026-27 cycle opened April 30, 2026. Each program sets its own deadline, and many review on a rolling basis, so aim to submit well before the date on the program's page. Confirm fees and dates with CASPA and each program before you pay.

items: Note each program's deadline and whether it's rolling
Check prerequisites against your transcript
Check minimum hours, GPA and any test (GRE, PA-CAT)
Note any supplemental application or fee
Budget CASPA: $185 first program + $65 each extra
Order official transcripts from every college attended
Include schools whose credits transferred
Enter your US coursework exactly as the transcript shows
Order official test scores to CASPA
Sort each role: patient care, healthcare or other
Average weekly hours you actually worked, not planned
Don't count the same hours in two categories
Supervisor name and contact for every entry
Shadowing logged, ideally with a PA
Request at least 2 (CASPA takes up to 5)
Match what each program asks for, e.g. a PA
Decide on the right-to-view waiver (it can't be changed)
Answer why you want to be a PA, specifically
Under 5,000 characters, spaces included
Have one person read it for clarity
Proofread: it can't be edited after you submit
Fee waiver? Request it BEFORE you submit
Add every program before you hit submit
Pay CASPA and any program fees
Save a PDF of the whole application
Watch your status until it says Verified
Verification can take up to 10 business days
Chase missing transcripts or evaluations fast
Fix an Undelivered application the same day
Send each program's supplemental, if it has one
Log new hours to mention in interviews
Reread your application before each interview
Track every program's status in one place

pins.title: PA School Application Checklist (CASPA, Step by Step)
pins.description: Everything a CASPA application needs, in order: programs and prerequisites, transcripts, patient care and healthcare hours, evaluations and the personal statement. Plus a free printable checklist to tick off as you go. You've got this!

pins.quote: $185 for your first program, $65 for each one after
pins.headline: Budget before you apply
pins.sub: What 5, 10 or 15 programs costs + a free checklist
pins.title: How Much Does CASPA Cost? 2026-27 PA School Application Fees
pins.description: CASPA charges $185 for the first program and $65 for each additional one in the 2026-27 cycle, so 10 programs is $770 before any program fees. What that adds up to, how fee waivers work, and a free printable PA application checklist.

pins.headline: PA school application checklist
pins.sub: Before you submit, then verification and after
pins.title: Free Printable: PA School Application Checklist for CASPA
pins.description: A free two-page printable for PA school applicants: programs, transcripts, hours, evaluations and personal statement on page one, then submitting, verification and what to do after on page two. Print it and check things off!

pins.headline: Applying to PA school this cycle?
pins.sub: Patient care vs healthcare hours: how CASPA sorts them, and why it matters
pins.title: Patient Care vs Healthcare Experience Hours on CASPA
pins.description: CASPA counts patient care experience (you're directly responsible for the patient, like an EMT or nurse) separately from healthcare experience (like scribing). How to sort your hours without double counting, plus a free PA application checklist.

pins.headline: After you hit submit on CASPA
pins.title: After You Submit CASPA: Verification and What Comes Next
pins.description: What to do after you submit your PA school application: watch for Verified status, chase missing transcripts and evaluations, send each program's supplemental and get ready for interviews. Free printable checklist. Almost there!
